children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of cash management and Treasury bills on Monday:
BTr awards 45.67 billion Philippine pesos ($728.46 million), below the 52 billion pesos offer, of which:
BTr awards 8.915 billion pesos worth of 35-day cash management bills, below 10 billion pesos programme at an average rate of 5.229%.
Tenders total 10.72 billion for cash management bills
BTR awards 36.755 billion pesos worth of T-bills, below 42 billion pesos programme:
BTr awards 14.755 billion pesos of 91-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.667%, below 20 billion pesos programme
BTr fully awards 15 billion pesos of 182-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.971%
BTr fully awards 7 billion pesos of 364-day T-bills at avg rate of 6.214%
Tenders total 68.59 billion pesos for T-bills
Details are on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph
